notes.title: New UI launched
notes.content:
After our game was launched on steam, we have received praise and suggestions from many players.

As for praise, thank you for your affirmation. Don't worry, we will not be proud, and we will work harder in the future, so that we can live up to the encouragement and support of all players!

As for the suggestions, the UI (game interface) of the game with the most opinions is too fancy, like hand games and page games.

Your opinion is the mission we must accomplish!

As soon as we received the comments, we made a plan to remake the UI. After nearly a month's overtime update design and repeated testing, our UI can finally meet you!

Let's experience the brand new lost CyberCity!


This update also optimizes:

1. After hanging up for a certain period of time, the main task disappears (thanks for the valuable suggestions of enthusiastic players)

2. Optimized sequence and dialogue
